Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 10

“Our army, protected by Bhishma, is insufficient, while their army, protected by Bhima, is sufficient.”

This much-debated verse has puzzled commentators for centuries — Duryodhana seems to admit his own side's limits despite Bhishma's leadership, revealing a private anxiety beneath his public bravado.
